translations.web: He who sent me is with me. The Father hasn’t left me alone, for I always do the things that are pleasing to him.”
translations.bsb: He who sent Me is with Me. He has not left Me alone, because I always do what pleases Him.”
translations.kjv: And he that sent me is with me: the Father hath not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.
translations.asv: And he that sent me is with me; he hath not left me alone; for I do always the things that are pleasing to him.
